_comment: Corporate actions Yahoo reports in its 'Stock Splits' field that are NOT share splits.
Yahoo has one field for every price-basis-changing action, and yfinance surfaces it with
no type discriminator, so a spin-off arrives looking exactly like a split.
Anything listed here is dropped at ingest: it never reaches marketData.splits, so nothing
downstream applies it. That matters most for share counts — HoldingServiceImpl.accumulate
multiplies transaction quantities by every split dated after them, so a phantom 1.057 turns
5 shares into 5.228. Transaction prices and average cost are never rewritten; dropping the
action simply leaves the booked figures alone.
How to spot one: real splits are board-declared in round terms (2:1, 3:2, 1:10). A ratio like
1057:1000 is a computed price quotient — the signature of a spin-off. Ingest logs a WARNING
for any unlisted ratio between 0.85 and 1.18, which is where these land; add an entry here
when one shows up and is not a real split.
Matching is on ticker + calendar date, and on yf_ratio when given (tolerance, not equality).
A different ratio on the same date does NOT match — it is treated as a new, unreviewed action.
action_type: SPINOFF | OTHER. Genuine SPLIT and STOCK_DIVIDEND actions do not belong here —
they really do change the share count and must stay applied.
ratio_overrides is the opposite list: real actions whose ratio Yahoo reports at too few
digits. Same ticker + date (+ yf_ratio) matching; instead of dropping the action, the ratio
is replaced at ingest, so the corrected value is what reaches marketData.splits. Prefer
ratio_numerator/ratio_denominator — the RNS states a fraction, and writing 8/9 out as a
decimal is a typo waiting to happen; exact_ratio is the fallback for a non-fractional value.
An overridden ratio is treated as reviewed, so it does not also raise the band warning.
_merge_list overwrites same-day entries, so one refresh of the ticker heals a stored ratio;
holdings then need a recalculation to pick the corrected share count up.

ignored.note: Spin-off of Mobility Global Inc. (NYSE: MBGL), effective 12:01 a.m. ET 2026-07-01, record date 2026-06-15, one MBGL share per SPGI share. SPGI share count unchanged; only the price basis moved.

ratio_overrides.note: Unilever share consolidation, 8 new shares for every 9 existing (ADS holders likewise 8-for-9), effective 2025-12-09, alongside the demerger of The Magnum Ice Cream Company. A genuine share-count change, so it must stay applied — but Yahoo reports the ratio as 0.888 rather than 8/9 = 0.888888..., which shaves 0.0053 off every 6 shares held. The action falls in the spin-off warning band and was reviewed: it is the consolidation, not the TMICC demerger.
